name: g_MenuScrollDirectionValueUnwritten
evidence: Data word initialised to 0x123 that no code writes; its only reader, Menu_InitScrollDirection (save/game_data.c), sets g_MenuScrollStep to 4 when it is below 300 (0x12C) and -4 otherwise, so retail always picks 4.

name: g_SceneRoomNameEmptyString
evidence: Zero small-data byte never written; Scene_LoadRoom copies it to name[0] and clears name[1..6] with memset(name + 1, 0, 6), which is exactly what cc1 2.7.2 -G8 emits for `char name[7] = ""` (lbu of the one-byte .sdata literal "\0" via $gp, then memset of the rest; checked by compiling the declaration).

name: g_BattleStartClearedByteWriteOnly
evidence: Byte between g_BattleStepIndex and g_BattleSuspendedModeState; Battle_StartEncounter (battle/encounter.c) clears it with them and no code in main or any overlay reads it.

name: g_DrawLightingParamsSetWriteOnly
evidence: Draw_SetLightingParams (draw/textbox.c) stores 1 here with the three shorts below and the highlight RGB; that function has no caller in main or the overlays and no code reads the byte.

name: g_DrawLightingParam1WriteOnly

name: g_DrawLightingParam2WriteOnly

name: g_MenuItemPrimListHandles[1]
evidence: Element 1 of g_MenuItemPrimListHandles (0x8009CFA0, int[2]). Menu_StepItemGrid2 builds the mode 0x2A dialog whose label is g_MenuItemLabelBuffer + 0x40 and stores prim list 0x4A here; Menu_DrawItemLabel reads g_MenuItemPrimListHandles[selected_base - 0x29] and flushes it, so mode 0x2A reads this word. Written as the member; sym.main.txt sizes the array (size:0x8) so splat no longer labels its interior.

name: g_MenuArmorCapacityModBlocked
evidence: Menu_OpenItemList stores Inv_CheckItemEquippable(list, slot) == 5. Status 5 is returned only when the source is Aya's equipped armor (g_AyaEquippedArmorSlot[0]) carrying a mod with code 8..10, Inv_CheckFreeSlotCapacity(1 << (code - 8)) (1, 2 or 4 slots) fails, and the selected mod is not that one. Menu_InventoryItemHandler reads it: with the flag set an even cell opens the item list instead of the action submenu.

name: g_InvScratchWordAWriteOnly
evidence: Inv_InitWayneStorage stores 0 here next to the buffer pointer; no reader.

name: g_InvScratchWordBWriteOnly
evidence: Inv_InitWayneStorage stores 0 here next to the buffer pointer; no reader.

name: g_InvScratchBufferUnused

name: g_BonusPointStatClearedWordsWriteOnly
evidence: int[7] after g_StatBaseTable (the 0x18-byte splat 'unreferenced pad' plus D_800A18B0, the loop's start element [6]); the bonus-point screen setup in menu/item_actions.c clears all seven next to g_BonusPointStatDeltas/g_BonusPointStatMultipliers and nothing reads them. Sized in sym.main.txt (size:0x1C), so the interior label D_800A18B0 is gone.

name: g_MemCardSaveFileSizeWriteOnly
evidence: Save_BuildCardFile (memcard/save_flow.c) stores 0x2000, the size of the one-block save file it then builds (bzero(g_MemCardFileBuffer, 0x2000)); no code reads it.

name: g_ObjectTextureBlobMidWriteOnly
evidence: g_GameState + 0x170 (field renamed unk_170 -> object_texture_blob_mid). Draw_InitDisplay (pm/disc_tables.c) and Boot_InitMemoryLayout (asset/game_state.c) store object_texture_blob + 0x2400, the middle of the 0x4800-byte object texture blob; no code in main or the overlays reads the word or the field.

name: FieldFx_RegisterOwnerContact
evidence: fieldfx/collision.c: when the effect owner is an active actor (FieldFx_GetStatus 3) in action state 2, sets 0x4000 in the player combatant's stateFlags and bit 31 in the owner's core_flags, the same pair Entity_CheckActionIdMatch sets when an enemy contact action id matches (field/actor_collision.c) and the room grab attack sets on contact; returns whether the contact was taken. Called by the ROOM_REARM_TIMER_TICK effects and the room_lib effects when their hit flag is set and the hold timer has run out.
